basic_details.short_information: Sardar Patel University, Vallabh Vidyanagar will hold a walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 (Thursday) from 11:30 am at the Office of the Vice Chancellor (VC Office, S.P. University Main Office Building), Sardar Patel University, Vallabh Vidyanagar – 388 120. The interview is for 2 posts of Warden for the university's Boys Hostels, on a purely temporary basis, with a fixed remuneration of Rs. 20,000 per month. Candidates come to the interview with the prescribed application form, their documents and a Demand Draft for the fee (advertisement No. B/SF/5354, dated 06/11/2026).

how_to_apply: Take the prescribed application form for Warden for the Boys Hostel, given with the notice and on the university website www.spuvvn.edu/careers/.
Type the form neatly in Microsoft Word using Arial Unicode font of size 11; if a column does not apply, write "Not Applicable", and increase rows or columns if the space is insufficient.
Affix the latest 3.5 cm x 3.5 cm photograph on the form.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates supporting qualifications, experience, age and all other claims, in the sequence set in the form, with page numbering.
Fill the address slip page with your full name and postal address with PIN code.
If you are already employed, forward the application through proper channel, with the "No Objection" declaration in the form signed by your employer.
Bring the hard copy of the form, the Demand Draft and the documents to the VC Office, S.P. University Main Office Building on 26 November 2026 at 11:30 am.

content_sections.heading: SPU Warden Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not print a separate last date for applications; candidates bring the completed application form to the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: About SPU Warden
content_sections.text: Sardar Patel University is a university at Vallabh Vidyanagar in Anand district, Gujarat; its notice states that it is NAAC accredited with Grade 'A' (10-01-2023 to 09-01-2028). The Warden posts are ad-hoc administrative posts in the University Boys Hostel section, covering the Mens (Nehru Hall) Hostel, C.T.E. Hostel, MBA-NRI Hostel and Old Hostel. The notice is issued by Dr. Bhailalbhai P. Patel, Registrar.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The university will fill 2 posts of Warden for the Boys Hostels. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 2 posts. Ex-serviceman will be given priority. A candidate shall possess a Bachelor Degree in any Stream from any of the Universities established or incorporated by or under the Central or State Act in India; or any other educational institution recognized as such or declared as deemed to be a University under section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956; or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government. Proficiency in managing records, documentation and use of email/MS Office/Google Workspace. It is mandatory to stay in university campus. Experience of managing residential campus hostels. Excellent communication skills and proven ability to handle young adult learners with empathy and firmness. Trained in conflict resolution, student counselling or wellness facilitation. Minimum 25 years and maximum 58 years, as on the last date of application submission. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Accommodation facility is provided in the campus with nominal charges. The post is purely on temporary basis for 11 months or as per requirement from time to time, whichever is earlier. The application form describes the post as Ad-hoc/Contractual for 2026-2027. The fee is paid by Demand Draft in favour of "Registrar, Sardar Patel University, Vallabh Vidyanagar" and is non-refundable. The DD is brought along with the application form on the interview day. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Warden post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Take the prescribed application form for Warden for the Boys Hostel, given with the notice and on the university website www.spuvvn.edu/careers/ . Type the form neatly in Microsoft Word using Arial Unicode font of size 11; if a column does not apply, write "Not Applicable", and increase rows or columns if the space is insufficient. Affix the latest 3.5 cm x 3.5 cm photograph on the form. Attach self-attested copies of certificates supporting qualifications, experience, age and all other claims, in the sequence set in the form, with page numbering. Fill the address slip page with your full name and postal address with PIN code. If you are already employed, forward the application through proper channel, with the "No Objection" declaration in the form signed by your employer. Bring the hard copy of the form, the Demand Draft and the documents to the VC Office, S.P. University Main Office Building on 26 November 2026 at 11:30 am.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Hard copy of the typed application form with the photograph affixed. Demand Draft of Rs. 250/- (S.C./S.T.) or Rs. 300/- (other candidates). Original and photocopies of marksheets, a passport size photograph and other certificates, if any. Address slip on one separate page. Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate (showing the date of birth). S.S.C. / H.S.C. marksheets; graduation marksheets and degree certificate; postgraduate, B.Ed./M.Ed. and other qualification certificates where held. PAN Card, Aadhaar Card and Election Card. Testimonials / experience certificates. SC/ST certificate if applicable; the form also asks SEBC candidates for a caste validity and non-creamy-layer certificate, and married candidates for a marriage certificate.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the SPU Warden walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026 (Thursday) from 11:30 am at the VC Office, S.P. University Main Office Building, Sardar Patel University, Vallabh Vidyanagar – 388 120.

faq.question: Q2. How many Warden posts are vacant?
faq.answer: Sardar Patel University has advertised 2 posts of Warden for its Boys Hostels.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the SPU Warden post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor Degree in any stream from a recognised university, a deemed university under section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government, with proficiency in records, documentation and email/MS Office/Google Workspace.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the SPU Warden post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be minimum 25 years and maximum 58 years of age as on the last date of application submission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an SPU Warden?
faq.answer: The remuneration is fixed at Rs. 20,000 per month, and accommodation is provided in the campus with nominal charges.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 250/- for S.C./S.T. candidates and Rs. 300/- for other candidates, paid by non-refundable Demand Draft in favour of "Registrar, Sardar Patel University, Vallabh Vidyanagar".

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the typed application form with photograph, the Demand Draft, original and photocopies of marksheets, a passport size photograph and self-attested certificates for qualification, experience, age and other claims, arranged in the order set in the form.

faq.question: Q8. Is the SPU Warden job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely on temporary basis for 11 months or as per requirement from time to time, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Does the Warden have to live on campus?
faq.answer: Yes, staying in the university campus is mandatory for the Warden post.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets priority in SPU Warden selection?
faq.answer: The notice states that ex-serviceman will be given priority.
